multiple accounts to get around a platform's account policy, anti-linkage tricks

vote rings, sockpuppets, bought accounts, undisclosed affiliation
brand content presented as independent content
copying competitors' creative, images, copy or reviews
refunds or gifts in exchange for reviews

any write on a no-touch browser profile
